facts.fact: An incident at the RSTP-run National Data Centre disrupted at least 12 government digital services (Government in Your Hand app, e-Visa, company registration, government website, IFMIS, Elderly Grant payment, Deeds Registration and others), indicating state systems are hosted there; RSTP first acknowledged the outage on 2026-09-18.
